newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Roche names new research head.
newsitem.headline: Roche names new research head.

text.p: Roche Holding AG said it named Jonathan Knowles, head of research for Glaxo-Wellcome Europe, to succeed Juergen Drews as head of Roche group pharmaceutical research.
Drews, who has been head of Roche research since 1986, is retiring both as head of research and from the executive committee.
Knowles has been director of the Glaxo Institute for Molecular Biology in Geneva since 1989 in addition to heading up research for Glaxo Wellcome Europe.
He will join Roche on September 1, and effective January 1, 1998, he will assume responsibility for group pharmaceutical research as a member of the executive committee, Roche also said.
